archived_reference.note: quoted from four round directories that are open PRs, not main; vendored because the post-merge tree, not this firing, is what certifies them; no verdict of this round depends on them

arms.as_is: the round-6/50/51 template, certified byte-identical to the archived rows
arms.enumerate: same facts, same query, reachable set asked for first (a task variant: it cannot show the as-is task is solvable, only whether an as-is failure co-occurs with a self-organized search)
arms.listing: non-ladder control, no relation and no entities, asked to write 1..4000 and then DONE

dispatch_order: health, cap-2048 as-is pair, duplicate control, gold-yes natural-stop control, enumerate pair, listing at 2048, cap-1536 pair, listing at 1024, cap-1024 pair, cap-512 pair: the decisive same-prompt anchors go first so a wall-clock cutoff costs the low-cap rungs and not the replication
flags: R1 coverage_ratio < 1.0 in both as-is cap-2048 records -> traversal_unfinished_at_hook

hypotheses.H1_proportional_budget: the stop lands at 1556*cap//2048 (band 8 tokens) with finish_reason stop and the marker sentence present at every cap
hypotheses.H2_absolute_budget: for every cap below the pin the output reaches the cap itself with finish_reason length, no marker and no answer
hypotheses.H3_no_serving_budget: lengths track the task; the marker appears wherever the model writes it; the pin is a property of the family on the class

items.rule: three seeds certified against the archived digests before any dispatch: the two k = 48 gold-no items round 51 delivered wrong, and the gold-yes item whose archived natural stop 1310 sits below the pin

question_blob: Does the 1,556-token stop that two firings on this deployment produced at the 2048 cap come from the traversal or from a budget in the serving stack? Hold the prompt bytes fixed, move the requested cap to 512, 1024 and 1536, and ask whether the stop length and the self-termination marker move with the cap.
readout_policy: the answer channel only for every verdict (issue #94); trace text is stored for marker position, listing extent and entity coverage only, never as a verdict

rows.text: the cap ladder below the pin lands at the predicted hook: 6 records (2 items x caps 512, 1024, 1536), measured tokens within 8 of 1556*cap//2048, finish_reason stop, marker present

rows.band: reported; 5 of 6 or more refuses C1 and the H1 reading
rows.text: the absolute-budget signature at the same 6 records: tokens equal the requested cap, finish_reason length, no marker
the marker appears in every predicted-hook record and in no natural-stop record (0 disagreements)
the gold-yes item whose archived natural stop was 1310 stays below the hook at cap 2048: delivered, finish_reason stop, no marker, tokens below 1556
the non-ladder listing control is cut by the same hook at caps 2048 and 1024 (predicted lengths, marker present, DONE absent)

rows.band: 2 of 2 for the recovery flag; 0 of 2 keeps the ceiling
rows.text: the enumerate arm delivers the gold label on both items round 51 delivered wrong, and its own list equals the independent BFS reachable set
issue #100 self-agreement: the duplicate re-dispatch of the same request is byte-identical to its twin (trace and answer)
same-prompt cross-firing against the archived rows of round 51 on the certified pair: same finish_reason and same answer-channel readout for both items, with the serving-id digest comparison stated
markers that appear below the predicted hook are counted as anomalies, never as hook hits (round 51's archived rung record is one: marker at 532 tokens where the prediction was 778)
issue #105 field census on every record: the message field names and the reasoning-supplying field (reasoning_content if non-empty, else reasoning, else empty)
traversal completeness at the hook, as-is cap-2048 records only: the fraction of the item's entities the run mentioned before the cut, and whether the query target was mentioned

tier_rule: serving_budget_hook if C1 >= 5 of 6 and C2 <= 1 of 6 and C5 == 2 of 2
no_serving_budget if C1 <= 2 of 6 and C5 == 0 of 2
